items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Financial Services
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出金融服務版 ChatGPT
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced a tailored ChatGPT Work product pairing GPT-6 Astra with hosted premium data from Daloopa, PitchBook, LSEG News and Crunchbase, plus firm Excel/Word/PowerPoint templates. Design partners are Morgan Stanley and Evercore. Users can trace figures to source paragraphs and tables.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出針對金融業的 ChatGPT Work 產品，以 GPT-6 Astra 搭配 Daloopa、PitchBook、LSEG News、Crunchbase 等託管數據，並可用公司自有 Excel／Word／PowerPoint 範本。設計夥伴為摩根士丹利與 Evercore，數字可追溯至原文段落與表格。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a vertical go-to-market layer on Astra, not a new foundation model: OpenAI is competing on licensed data, citations and auditability inside regulated banks. What remains unproven is conversion from design-partner demos to paid seats and whether citations hold under compliance review.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 Astra 的垂直落地，不是新基礎模型；競爭點在授權數據、引用與可審計性。尚未驗證的是設計夥伴演示能否轉成付費席次，以及引用在合規審查下是否站得住。
items_flat.quote: Now available: ChatGPT for Financial Services. This is a tailored ChatGPT Work experience that combines built-in financial data with GPT-6 Astra’s reasoning.
items_flat.quote_zh: 現已推出：金融服務版 ChatGPT。這是結合內建金融數據與 GPT-6 Astra 推理能力的客製化 ChatGPT Work 體驗。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI opens Agents API public beta
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 開放 Agents API 公開測試
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI launched the Agents API in public beta so developers can create cloud agents in one call using the hosted Codex harness. Agents can run in OpenAI-hosted sandboxes or customer/partner infrastructure, with MCP tools and optional multi-agent subagents. There is no extra API fee beyond model tokens and paid tools.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 將 Agents API 以公開測試推出，開發者可用託管 Codex harness 一次呼叫建立雲端代理。代理可跑在 OpenAI 沙盒或客戶／夥伴基礎設施，支援 MCP 與可選多代理。除模型 token 與付費工具外無額外 API 費。
items_flat.analysis_en: The product move is to productize Codex’s long-running harness as infrastructure rather than a chat feature. Reliability, permissions and customer-owned sandboxes will decide whether this becomes the default agent runtime.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉是把 Codex 長時程 harness 產品化成基礎設施，而非聊天功能。能否成為預設代理執行層，取決於可靠性、權限與客戶自有沙盒。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing the Agents API in public beta, bringing that same harness and infrastructure that powers Codex to developers through a simple, flexible API.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們今天以公開測試推出 Agents API，把驅動 Codex 的同一套 harness 與基礎設施，透過簡單彈性的 API 交給開發者。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic publishes September 2026 Claude misuse threat report
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 發布 2026 年 9 月 Claude 濫用威脅報告
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s Threat Intelligence team published its most detailed report to date on disrupted Claude misuse from December 2025–August 2026 across cyber, influence, surveillance, scams, biology, conventional weapons and illicit distillation. The company says it disrupted every operation in the report and shared findings with authorities and other labs where appropriate.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 威脅情報團隊發布迄今最詳細報告，涵蓋 2025 年 12 月至 2026 年 8 月遭阻斷的 Claude 濫用：網路攻擊、影響力操作、監控、詐騙、生物、常規武器與非法蒸餾。公司稱報告中每起行動均已阻斷，並在適當時與執法單位及其他實驗室共享。
items_flat.analysis_en: The report is a safety-and-geopolitics document more than a product launch: it argues on-platform classifiers are now necessary because models can substitute for scarce military and intelligence skills. Independent confirmation of case details remains limited to Anthropic’s own write-up.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這份文件偏安全與地緣政治，而非產品發布：它主張平台內分類器已成必要，因為模型可替代稀缺的軍情技能。個案細節目前仍主要來自 Anthropic 自身記述。
items_flat.quote: We're publishing our most detailed threat intelligence report to date. It covers how people tried to misuse Claude—for cyberattacks, influence operations, surveillance, biology, and building weapons—and how we found and stopped them.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們發布迄今最詳細的威脅情報報告，涵蓋有人如何試圖濫用 Claude 從事網路攻擊、影響力操作、監控、生物與武器研製，以及我們如何發現並阻止。

items_flat.title_en: Altman tells staff OpenAI is open to pacing frontier development
items_flat.title_zh: Altman 向員工表示 OpenAI 願意放慢前沿開發節奏
items_flat.summary_en: Bloomberg, corroborated by Reuters, reported that Sam Altman told employees in a company-wide meeting this week that OpenAI could pace frontier development, possibly with other labs, though some may refuse. Reuters added that an Anthropic spokesperson said the company is interested in industry coordination on release pace.
items_flat.summary_zh: 彭博報導、路透轉述：Sam Altman 本週在全員會上表示，OpenAI 可放慢前沿開發，或與其他實驗室同步，但部分實驗室可能拒絕。路透並引述 Anthropic 發言人稱該公司有意就發布節奏與產業協調。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a policy and coordination story, not a product ship: the lab is signaling willingness to slow while still launching finance and agent products the same week. Whether a coordinated pause is legally or commercially workable remains unconfirmed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是政策與協調敘事，不是產品出貨；實驗室在同一週仍推出金融與代理產品的同時釋放出可放慢的訊號。協同暫停在法律與商業上是否可行仍未證實。
items_flat.quote: Altman told employees that OpenAI could potentially pace its AI development — perhaps in conjunction with several other AI labs, but that some may not agree to do so.
items_flat.quote_zh: Altman 告訴員工，OpenAI 有可能放慢 AI 開發節奏——或許與其他幾家實驗室一同進行，但有些實驗室可能不同意。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI and GSA expand OneGov deal: $0 seats and 50% off usage
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 與 GSA 擴大 OneGov 協議：席次免費、用量五折
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI for Government and the U.S. GSA announced a 27-month OneGov agreement effective 1 Oct 2026–31 Dec 2028. Eligible federal, state, local and tribal entities get a $0 license fee (from $15/user/month), no minimum spend, and 50% off token usage, plus expanded public-sector cyber-defender support. GSA said prior AI deals helped about 3.5 million federal employees.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI for Government 與美國 GSA 宣布 27 個月 OneGov 協議，自 2026-10-01 至 2028-12-31。聯邦、州、地方與部落機構可享原價每月 15 美元的席次改為 0 元、無最低消費，以及 token 用量五折，並擴大公共部門網路防禦支援。GSA 稱先前 AI 協議已覆蓋約 350 萬聯邦員工。
items_flat.analysis_en: This replaces last year’s $1-per-year pilot with consumption pricing and widens eligibility beyond federal staff. Actual onboarding among the claimed ~23 million eligible public servants, and which models sit in FedRAMP environments, will determine impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此協議取代去年每年 1 美元試點，改為用量計價並擴大到聯邦以外。真正影響取決於號稱約 2300 萬合格公職人員的實際導入，以及哪些模型進入 FedRAMP 環境。
items_flat.quote: This first-of-its-kind agreement will provide $0 access—normally $15 per user per month—for the license fee and 50% off usage, alongside expanded support for public-sector cyber defenders.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這份前所未有的協議將把通常每用戶每月 15 美元的授權費降為 0 元，用量五折，並擴大對公共部門網路防禦人員的支援。

items_flat.title_en: GPT-Live-1 now generally available in the API
items_flat.title_zh: GPT-Live-1 於 API 全面開放
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI made GPT-Live-1 generally available on the Live Sessions API for full-duplex voice apps. The voice layer is $0.05 per minute billed per second; backend reasoning and tools are billed separately via Responses or client delegation.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 讓 GPT-Live-1 在 Live Sessions API 全面可用，供全雙工語音應用。語音層每分鐘 0.05 美元、按秒計費；後端推理與工具另以 Responses 或客戶端委派計費。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is an API surface expansion of an existing ChatGPT voice stack, not a new text frontier model. The commercial question is whether full-duplex plus delegated Astra/Codex agents becomes the default voice-agent stack.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既有 ChatGPT 語音堆疊的 API 擴張，不是新的文字前沿模型。商業問題在於全雙工加上委派 Astra／Codex 代理，會否成為預設語音代理堆疊。
items_flat.quote: Voice sessions cost $0.05 per minute, billed per second. Backend model and tool usage is billed separately.
items_flat.quote_zh: 語音工作階段每分鐘 0.05 美元，按秒計費。後端模型與工具用量另行計費。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI adds a Data agent to ChatGPT Work
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 於 ChatGPT Work 新增 Data agent
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI launched a Data agent in ChatGPT Work that queries approved warehouses including BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks and Redshift and can pull Drive/SharePoint files to produce dashboards. Queries keep the connected account’s table, row and column permissions.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT Work 推出 Data agent，可查詢已核准的 BigQuery、Snowflake、Databricks、Redshift 等倉儲，並從 Drive／SharePoint 取檔產出儀表板。查詢沿用連線帳號的表、列、欄權限。
items_flat.analysis_en: Together with the finance SKU, this is OpenAI pushing ChatGPT Work from chat into BI. Accuracy, row-level security and hallucination of numbers remain the adoption gates.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 搭配金融版產品，這是 OpenAI 把 ChatGPT Work 從對話推進 BI。數字正確性、列級權限與幻覺仍是導入門檻。
items_flat.quote: Meet the new Data agent in ChatGPT Work: turn your company’s data into answers, interactive dashboards, and action, just by asking.
items_flat.quote_zh: 認識 ChatGPT Work 的新 Data agent：只要開口，就能把公司數據變成答案、互動儀表板與行動。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral and Cloudera partner on sovereign enterprise AI
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 與 Cloudera 合作主權企業 AI
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral announced a partnership with Cloudera to integrate its models into Cloudera’s hybrid data platform so enterprises can run inference in private, public, on-prem and air-gapped environments while keeping data under customer control. Cloudera cited about 30 exabytes of customer-managed data on the platform.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 宣布與 Cloudera 合作，將模型整合進 Cloudera 混合資料平台，企業可在私有、公有、地端與氣隙環境推論，數據仍由客戶掌控。Cloudera 稱平台上約有 30 EB 客戶託管資料。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a distribution and governance play, not a model launch: it targets regulated industries that will not send core data to US frontier APIs. What remains unproven is conversion from platform integration to paid model usage.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是通路與治理布局，不是模型發表；鎖定不願把核心數據送進美國前沿 API 的受管產業。平台整合能否轉成付費用量仍未驗證。
items_flat.quote: Our mission is to make frontier AI available to enterprises without requiring them to give up control over their data, infrastructure, or intellectual property.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們的使命是讓企業用上前沿 AI，而無須放棄對數據、基礎設施或智慧財產的掌控。

items_flat.title_en: Cognition releases SWE-2 coding model inside Devin
items_flat.title_zh: Cognition 於 Devin 內發布編碼模型 SWE-2
items_flat.summary_en: Cognition introduced SWE-2, post-trained from Moonshot’s 2.8T Kimi K3, and said it scores 50.0% on FrontierCode 1.1 Main versus 50.9% for Claude Fable 5.1 at what it claims is 64% lower cost. The model is available in Devin Desktop and CLI, not as open weights or a public API; Pro/Max/Teams get a one-month free window.
items_flat.summary_zh: Cognition 推出 SWE-2，以 Moonshot 2.8T 的 Kimi K3 後訓練，自稱 FrontierCode 1.1 Main 得 50.0%，對比 Claude Fable 5.1 的 50.9%，成本低約 64%。模型僅在 Devin Desktop／CLI 提供，非開源權重也非公開 API；Pro／Max／Teams 有一個月免費期。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a specialized coding-model release on a Chinese open-weight base, not a general frontier lab launch. Scores and the 64% cost claim are Cognition’s own; independent evals and Terminal-Bench 4 (27.3% vs Fable 5.1’s 55.8%) show the gap is uneven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是以中國開源權重為底的專用編碼模型，不是通用前沿實驗室發表。分數與成本降幅來自 Cognition 自身；獨立評測尚未出現，且 Terminal-Bench 4（27.3% 對 Fable 5.1 的 55.8%）顯示差距並不均勻。
items_flat.quote: Today we’re introducing SWE-2, our most advanced coding model yet. It pushes the Pareto frontier of capability and cost, achieving 50.0% on FrontierCode 1.1 Main, within one point of Fable 5.1 while being 64% cheaper.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們今天推出迄今最強編碼模型 SWE-2。它把能力與成本的柏拉圖前緣往前推，FrontierCode 1.1 Main 達 50.0%，距 Fable 5.1 不到 1 個百分點，成本低 64%。

items_flat.title_en: Google Pics now live for AI Pro/Ultra and Workspace
items_flat.title_zh: Google Pics 已對 AI Pro／Ultra 與 Workspace 上線
items_flat.summary_en: Google said Google Pics, built with Nano Banana, is available to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers and most Workspace business customers. The tool supports object isolation, in-image text edit/translation, multi-option generation and in-Docs/Slides editing.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 表示以 Nano Banana 打造的 Google Pics 已提供給 AI Pro、Ultra 訂戶及多數 Workspace 商務客戶。功能含物件分離、圖內文字編輯／翻譯、多方案生成，以及 Docs／Slides 內編輯。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a product-surface expansion of an existing image stack into Workspace, not a new foundation model. The competitive question is whether precise in-doc editing keeps users in Google’s suite.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既有圖像堆疊擴進 Workspace，不是新基礎模型。競爭點在於精準的文件內編輯能否把用戶留在 Google 套件。
items_flat.quote: Google Pics — our image creation and editing tool from Google Workspace — is rolling out over the coming weeks to all Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers and most Workspace business customers.
items_flat.quote_zh: Google Pics——Google Workspace 的圖像生成與編輯工具——將在未來數週推給所有 Google AI Pro、Ultra 訂戶及多數 Workspace 商務客戶。

items_flat.title_en: Google ships the Gemini app for Windows
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Windows 版 Gemini 應用
items_flat.summary_en: Google launched a native Gemini desktop app for Windows 10 and 11, opened with Alt+Space over the current window. The app includes chat history, Daily Brief, Nano Banana image and Gemini Omni video creation, and Gemini Spark for subscribers. It is available globally at gemini.google/desktop.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 推出 Windows 10／11 原生 Gemini 桌面應用，可用 Alt+Space 疊在當前視窗上。含聊天紀錄、Daily Brief、Nano Banana 圖像與 Gemini Omni 影片生成，訂戶可用 Gemini Spark。全球可於 gemini.google/desktop 下載。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a client distribution move after the April macOS app, not a model release. Whether a lightweight overlay plus Spark agent sticks on Windows depends on OS integration Google has not fully described.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是繼 4 月 macOS 應用後的客戶端鋪貨，不是模型發布。輕量疊層加上 Spark 代理能否在 Windows 站穩，取決於 Google 尚未完整說明的系統整合。
items_flat.quote: The new Gemini app for Windows lets you access AI help with a simple keyboard shortcut, directly from your desktop.
items_flat.quote_zh: 新的 Windows 版 Gemini 應用讓你用一個快捷鍵，直接從桌面取得 AI 協助。

items_flat.title_en: Musk highlights Grok Bot sales connectors and ongoing QoL updates
items_flat.title_zh: Musk 強調 Grok Bot 銷售串接與持續體驗更新
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk amplified Grok Bot notes that users can draft messages inline before sending and that Bots can now connect to Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Clay and Granola for sales workflows. On 11 Sep he also amplified a Grok Bot summary of SpaceX CFO remarks that included “Grok 4.7 coming soon.”
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 轉發 Grok Bot 說明：可先擬稿再核准送出，並可串接 Salesforce、HubSpot、Gong、Clay、Granola 做銷售流程。9 月 11 日他又轉發 Bot 對 SpaceX CFO 演講的摘要，其中提到「Grok 4.7 即將推出」。
items_flat.analysis_en: This remains an incremental agent-product tweak plus an unofficial timing hint, not a frontier-model event. Treat “coming soon” as Musk/CFO color until xAI posts a model ID, price or changelog.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這仍是代理產品的增量改進加上非正式時程暗示，不是前沿模型事件。「即將推出」在 xAI 公布模型代號、價格或更新日誌前，只能視為 Musk／CFO 的口頭說法。
items_flat.quote: Grok @Bot is great for sales teams!
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Bot 很適合銷售團隊！

openai.quote_zh: Altman 告訴員工，OpenAI 有可能放慢 AI 開發節奏——或許與其他幾家實驗室一同進行，但有些實驗室可能不同意。

openai.title_en: OpenAI and GSA expand OneGov deal: $0 seats and 50% off usage
openai.title_zh: OpenAI 與 GSA 擴大 OneGov 協議：席次免費、用量五折
openai.summary_en: OpenAI for Government and the U.S. GSA announced a 27-month OneGov agreement effective 1 Oct 2026–31 Dec 2028. Eligible federal, state, local and tribal entities get a $0 license fee (from $15/user/month), no minimum spend, and 50% off token usage, plus expanded public-sector cyber-defender support. GSA said prior AI deals helped about 3.5 million federal employees.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI for Government 與美國 GSA 宣布 27 個月 OneGov 協議，自 2026-10-01 至 2028-12-31。聯邦、州、地方與部落機構可享原價每月 15 美元的席次改為 0 元、無最低消費，以及 token 用量五折，並擴大公共部門網路防禦支援。GSA 稱先前 AI 協議已覆蓋約 350 萬聯邦員工。
openai.analysis_en: This replaces last year’s $1-per-year pilot with consumption pricing and widens eligibility beyond federal staff. Actual onboarding among the claimed ~23 million eligible public servants, and which models sit in FedRAMP environments, will determine impact.
openai.analysis_zh: 此協議取代去年每年 1 美元試點，改為用量計價並擴大到聯邦以外。真正影響取決於號稱約 2300 萬合格公職人員的實際導入，以及哪些模型進入 FedRAMP 環境。
openai.quote: This first-of-its-kind agreement will provide $0 access—normally $15 per user per month—for the license fee and 50% off usage, alongside expanded support for public-sector cyber defenders.
openai.quote_zh: 這份前所未有的協議將把通常每用戶每月 15 美元的授權費降為 0 元，用量五折，並擴大對公共部門網路防禦人員的支援。

openai.title_en: GPT-Live-1 now generally available in the API
openai.title_zh: GPT-Live-1 於 API 全面開放
openai.summary_en: OpenAI made GPT-Live-1 generally available on the Live Sessions API for full-duplex voice apps. The voice layer is $0.05 per minute billed per second; backend reasoning and tools are billed separately via Responses or client delegation.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 讓 GPT-Live-1 在 Live Sessions API 全面可用，供全雙工語音應用。語音層每分鐘 0.05 美元、按秒計費；後端推理與工具另以 Responses 或客戶端委派計費。
openai.analysis_en: This is an API surface expansion of an existing ChatGPT voice stack, not a new text frontier model. The commercial question is whether full-duplex plus delegated Astra/Codex agents becomes the default voice-agent stack.
openai.analysis_zh: 這是既有 ChatGPT 語音堆疊的 API 擴張，不是新的文字前沿模型。商業問題在於全雙工加上委派 Astra／Codex 代理，會否成為預設語音代理堆疊。
openai.quote: Voice sessions cost $0.05 per minute, billed per second. Backend model and tool usage is billed separately.
openai.quote_zh: 語音工作階段每分鐘 0.05 美元，按秒計費。後端模型與工具用量另行計費。

openai.title_en: OpenAI adds a Data agent to ChatGPT Work
openai.title_zh: OpenAI 於 ChatGPT Work 新增 Data agent
openai.summary_en: OpenAI launched a Data agent in ChatGPT Work that queries approved warehouses including BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks and Redshift and can pull Drive/SharePoint files to produce dashboards. Queries keep the connected account’s table, row and column permissions.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT Work 推出 Data agent，可查詢已核准的 BigQuery、Snowflake、Databricks、Redshift 等倉儲，並從 Drive／SharePoint 取檔產出儀表板。查詢沿用連線帳號的表、列、欄權限。
openai.analysis_en: Together with the finance SKU, this is OpenAI pushing ChatGPT Work from chat into BI. Accuracy, row-level security and hallucination of numbers remain the adoption gates.
openai.analysis_zh: 搭配金融版產品，這是 OpenAI 把 ChatGPT Work 從對話推進 BI。數字正確性、列級權限與幻覺仍是導入門檻。
openai.quote: Meet the new Data agent in ChatGPT Work: turn your company’s data into answers, interactive dashboards, and action, just by asking.
openai.quote_zh: 認識 ChatGPT Work 的新 Data agent：只要開口，就能把公司數據變成答案、互動儀表板與行動。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic publishes September 2026 Claude misuse threat report
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 發布 2026 年 9 月 Claude 濫用威脅報告
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic’s Threat Intelligence team published its most detailed report to date on disrupted Claude misuse from December 2025–August 2026 across cyber, influence, surveillance, scams, biology, conventional weapons and illicit distillation. The company says it disrupted every operation in the report and shared findings with authorities and other labs where appropriate.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 威脅情報團隊發布迄今最詳細報告，涵蓋 2025 年 12 月至 2026 年 8 月遭阻斷的 Claude 濫用：網路攻擊、影響力操作、監控、詐騙、生物、常規武器與非法蒸餾。公司稱報告中每起行動均已阻斷，並在適當時與執法單位及其他實驗室共享。
anthropic.analysis_en: The report is a safety-and-geopolitics document more than a product launch: it argues on-platform classifiers are now necessary because models can substitute for scarce military and intelligence skills. Independent confirmation of case details remains limited to Anthropic’s own write-up.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這份文件偏安全與地緣政治，而非產品發布：它主張平台內分類器已成必要，因為模型可替代稀缺的軍情技能。個案細節目前仍主要來自 Anthropic 自身記述。
anthropic.quote: We're publishing our most detailed threat intelligence report to date. It covers how people tried to misuse Claude—for cyberattacks, influence operations, surveillance, biology, and building weapons—and how we found and stopped them.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們發布迄今最詳細的威脅情報報告，涵蓋有人如何試圖濫用 Claude 從事網路攻擊、影響力操作、監控、生物與武器研製，以及我們如何發現並阻止。

google.title_en: Google Pics now live for AI Pro/Ultra and Workspace
google.title_zh: Google Pics 已對 AI Pro／Ultra 與 Workspace 上線
google.summary_en: Google said Google Pics, built with Nano Banana, is available to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers and most Workspace business customers. The tool supports object isolation, in-image text edit/translation, multi-option generation and in-Docs/Slides editing.
google.summary_zh: Google 表示以 Nano Banana 打造的 Google Pics 已提供給 AI Pro、Ultra 訂戶及多數 Workspace 商務客戶。功能含物件分離、圖內文字編輯／翻譯、多方案生成，以及 Docs／Slides 內編輯。
google.analysis_en: This is a product-surface expansion of an existing image stack into Workspace, not a new foundation model. The competitive question is whether precise in-doc editing keeps users in Google’s suite.
google.analysis_zh: 這是既有圖像堆疊擴進 Workspace，不是新基礎模型。競爭點在於精準的文件內編輯能否把用戶留在 Google 套件。
google.quote: Google Pics — our image creation and editing tool from Google Workspace — is rolling out over the coming weeks to all Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers and most Workspace business customers.
google.quote_zh: Google Pics——Google Workspace 的圖像生成與編輯工具——將在未來數週推給所有 Google AI Pro、Ultra 訂戶及多數 Workspace 商務客戶。

google.title_en: Google ships the Gemini app for Windows
google.title_zh: Google 推出 Windows 版 Gemini 應用
google.summary_en: Google launched a native Gemini desktop app for Windows 10 and 11, opened with Alt+Space over the current window. The app includes chat history, Daily Brief, Nano Banana image and Gemini Omni video creation, and Gemini Spark for subscribers. It is available globally at gemini.google/desktop.
google.summary_zh: Google 推出 Windows 10／11 原生 Gemini 桌面應用，可用 Alt+Space 疊在當前視窗上。含聊天紀錄、Daily Brief、Nano Banana 圖像與 Gemini Omni 影片生成，訂戶可用 Gemini Spark。全球可於 gemini.google/desktop 下載。
google.analysis_en: This is a client distribution move after the April macOS app, not a model release. Whether a lightweight overlay plus Spark agent sticks on Windows depends on OS integration Google has not fully described.
google.analysis_zh: 這是繼 4 月 macOS 應用後的客戶端鋪貨，不是模型發布。輕量疊層加上 Spark 代理能否在 Windows 站穩，取決於 Google 尚未完整說明的系統整合。
google.quote: The new Gemini app for Windows lets you access AI help with a simple keyboard shortcut, directly from your desktop.
google.quote_zh: 新的 Windows 版 Gemini 應用讓你用一個快捷鍵，直接從桌面取得 AI 協助。

xai.title_en: Musk highlights Grok Bot sales connectors and ongoing QoL updates
xai.title_zh: Musk 強調 Grok Bot 銷售串接與持續體驗更新
xai.summary_en: Elon Musk amplified Grok Bot notes that users can draft messages inline before sending and that Bots can now connect to Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Clay and Granola for sales workflows. On 11 Sep he also amplified a Grok Bot summary of SpaceX CFO remarks that included “Grok 4.7 coming soon.”
xai.summary_zh: Elon Musk 轉發 Grok Bot 說明：可先擬稿再核准送出，並可串接 Salesforce、HubSpot、Gong、Clay、Granola 做銷售流程。9 月 11 日他又轉發 Bot 對 SpaceX CFO 演講的摘要，其中提到「Grok 4.7 即將推出」。
xai.analysis_en: This remains an incremental agent-product tweak plus an unofficial timing hint, not a frontier-model event. Treat “coming soon” as Musk/CFO color until xAI posts a model ID, price or changelog.
xai.analysis_zh: 這仍是代理產品的增量改進加上非正式時程暗示，不是前沿模型事件。「即將推出」在 xAI 公布模型代號、價格或更新日誌前，只能視為 Musk／CFO 的口頭說法。
xai.quote: Grok @Bot is great for sales teams!
xai.quote_zh: Grok Bot 很適合銷售團隊！

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral and Cloudera partner on sovereign enterprise AI
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral 與 Cloudera 合作主權企業 AI
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral announced a partnership with Cloudera to integrate its models into Cloudera’s hybrid data platform so enterprises can run inference in private, public, on-prem and air-gapped environments while keeping data under customer control. Cloudera cited about 30 exabytes of customer-managed data on the platform.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral 宣布與 Cloudera 合作，將模型整合進 Cloudera 混合資料平台，企業可在私有、公有、地端與氣隙環境推論，數據仍由客戶掌控。Cloudera 稱平台上約有 30 EB 客戶託管資料。
frontier_other.analysis_en: This is a distribution and governance play, not a model launch: it targets regulated industries that will not send core data to US frontier APIs. What remains unproven is conversion from platform integration to paid model usage.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這是通路與治理布局，不是模型發表；鎖定不願把核心數據送進美國前沿 API 的受管產業。平台整合能否轉成付費用量仍未驗證。
frontier_other.quote: Our mission is to make frontier AI available to enterprises without requiring them to give up control over their data, infrastructure, or intellectual property.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 我們的使命是讓企業用上前沿 AI，而無須放棄對數據、基礎設施或智慧財產的掌控。

frontier_other.title_en: Cognition releases SWE-2 coding model inside Devin
frontier_other.title_zh: Cognition 於 Devin 內發布編碼模型 SWE-2
frontier_other.summary_en: Cognition introduced SWE-2, post-trained from Moonshot’s 2.8T Kimi K3, and said it scores 50.0% on FrontierCode 1.1 Main versus 50.9% for Claude Fable 5.1 at what it claims is 64% lower cost. The model is available in Devin Desktop and CLI, not as open weights or a public API; Pro/Max/Teams get a one-month free window.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Cognition 推出 SWE-2，以 Moonshot 2.8T 的 Kimi K3 後訓練，自稱 FrontierCode 1.1 Main 得 50.0%，對比 Claude Fable 5.1 的 50.9%，成本低約 64%。模型僅在 Devin Desktop／CLI 提供，非開源權重也非公開 API；Pro／Max／Teams 有一個月免費期。
frontier_other.analysis_en: This is a specialized coding-model release on a Chinese open-weight base, not a general frontier lab launch. Scores and the 64% cost claim are Cognition’s own; independent evals and Terminal-Bench 4 (27.3% vs Fable 5.1’s 55.8%) show the gap is uneven.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這是以中國開源權重為底的專用編碼模型，不是通用前沿實驗室發表。分數與成本降幅來自 Cognition 自身；獨立評測尚未出現，且 Terminal-Bench 4（27.3% 對 Fable 5.1 的 55.8%）顯示差距並不均勻。
frontier_other.quote: Today we’re introducing SWE-2, our most advanced coding model yet. It pushes the Pareto frontier of capability and cost, achieving 50.0% on FrontierCode 1.1 Main, within one point of Fable 5.1 while being 64% cheaper.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 我們今天推出迄今最強編碼模型 SWE-2。它把能力與成本的柏拉圖前緣往前推，FrontierCode 1.1 Main 達 50.0%，距 Fable 5.1 不到 1 個百分點，成本低 64%。

brief_en: OpenAI shipped finance ChatGPT, Agents API beta, Data agent, GPT-Live-1 API GA and a 27-month GSA deal ($0 seat, 50% usage). Altman told staff he is open to pacing frontier work. Anthropic published its September misuse report. Google rolled Gemini for Windows; Mistral partnered with Cloudera; Cognition released SWE-2.
brief_zh: OpenAI 推出金融版 ChatGPT、Agents API 公測、Data agent、GPT-Live-1 API 正式上線，並與 GSA 簽 27 個月 $0 席次／用量五折協議；Altman 對員工表示可放慢前沿節奏。Anthropic 發布 9 月濫用威脅報告。Google 推出 Windows 版 Gemini；Mistral 攜手 Cloudera；Cognition 發布 SWE-2。
